title: Book VI
coreMove: Keep duty independent of mood, image, and convenience while staying social.
sourcePressure: Cosmic order widens self-command into public reason: duty holds in cold, warmth, praise, blame, life, death, and the bee is not separate from the swarm.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: do your duty by pleasing everyone or seeking public image

sourceAnchors.name: Antoninus rather than Caesar
sourceAnchors.detail: Book VI gathers the instruction to imitate Antoninus rather than Caesar.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Antoninus becomes the model when public work tempts the soul to dress itself as power.

sourceAnchors.name: the swarm and the bee
sourceAnchors.detail: Book VI says what is not good for the swarm is not good for the bee.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The bee cannot call itself successful while damaging the hive that makes its work possible.

counterintuition: what looks like control is actually surrender
the real problem is not outside you

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person direct address, retrospective recognition, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

exampleSpecs.audience: Julien reviewing a cheaper supplier bid
exampleSpecs.stakes: savings could shift hidden risk to nurses and patients
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Julien asks the nurse lead to test the cheaper tubing before the committee votes.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: The sample box sits unopened beside a spreadsheet of savings.

exampleSpecs.audience: Anna choosing a shortcut before a public holiday
exampleSpecs.stakes: looking efficient could leave hazards for families
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Anna delays the photo-op planting and fixes the loose playground bolt first.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A swing chain clicks wrong in the empty park.

exampleSpecs.audience: Kiran under pressure to soften a finding
exampleSpecs.stakes: praise from partners conflicts with the larger trust of the report
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Kiran reads the control failure aloud in plain words and leaves it in the report.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: "If we remove that sentence, the report stops being ours."

exampleSpecs.audience: Astrid deciding who gets scarce microscope time
exampleSpecs.stakes: favoring her own project would injure the shared lab
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: What is the bee owed when the swarm owns the microscope?
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Astrid posts a transparent rotation and takes the inconvenient midnight slot herself.

exampleSpecs.stakes: weather becomes an excuse to relax a life-saving drill
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: At 7:40 p.m., Michael runs the hose-pack drill again because cold fingers are part of the real call.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: At 7:40 p.m., rain beads on the engine bay floor.

exampleSpecs.stakes: a popular discount would undercut staff wages
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: You see Isabel trace the discount through payroll before voting against applause.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: You see the vote tally before anyone sees the payroll gap.

rhythmVariety.deepReadParagraphLengthMix: at least one paragraph 3 sentences or shorter, at least one paragraph 5+ sentences, at least one one-sentence punch line
rhythmVariety.fullReadInterludeRequirement: at least one paragraph that breaks the scene-then-rule rhythm: a question to the reader, a research aside, a direct second-person passage, or a brief historical reference
rhythmVariety.forbiddenRhythm: every paragraph following the pattern 'concrete anchor sentence -> abstract rule sentence -> elaboration sentence'

skillTargets: detect when private advantage harms the swarm

tryThisNowSpec: Before choosing the convenient response, ask whether it would still look right if the whole group had to live by it.
